Arabic text: بِسْمِ اللَّـهِ الرَّحْمَـٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ
Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

Arabic text: أَلْحَمْدُ للَّهِ الَّذِيْ خَلَقَ اللَّيْلَ وَالنَّهَارَ بِقُوَّتِهِ
Translation: All praise be to Allah who created the night and the day by His power

Arabic text: وَمَيَّزَ بَيْنَهُمَا بِقُدْرَتِهِ
Translation: And distinguished between them by His might

Arabic text: وَجَعَلَ لِكُلِّ وَاحِد مِنْهُمَا حَدًّا مَحْدُودًا، وَأَمَدًا مَمْدُودًا
Translation: And made for each of them a limited boundary, and an extended time

Arabic text: يُولِجُ كُلَّ وَاحِد مِنْهُمَا فِيْ صَاحِبِهِ
Translation: He causes each of them to enter into the other

Arabic text: وَيُولِجُ صَاحِبَهُ فِيْهِ بِتَقْدِير مِنْهُ لِلْعِبَادِ
Translation: And causes the other to enter into it by His decree for His servants

Arabic text: فِيمَا يَغْـذُوهُمْ بِـهِ وَيُنْشئُهُمْ عَلَيْـهِ
Translation: In what He nourishes them with and brings them up upon

Arabic text: فَخَلَقَ لَهُمُ اللَّيْـلَ لِيَسْكُنُوْا فِيْهِ مِنْ حَرَكَاتِ التَّعَبِ
Translation: So He created for them the night to rest therein from the movements of toil

Arabic text: وَنَهَضَاتِ النَّصَبِ، وَجَعَلَهُ لِبَاسًا لِيَلْبَسُوْا مِنْ رَاحَتِهِ وَمَنَامِهِ
Translation: And the strains of weariness, and made it a garment for them to wear of its comfort and sleep

Arabic text: فَيَكُونَ ذٰلِكَ جَمَامًا وَقُوَّةً، وَلِيَنَالُوْا بِهِ لَذَّةً وَشَهْوَةً
Translation: So that it would be a refreshment and strength, and that they might attain through it pleasure and desire

Arabic text: وَخَلَقَ لَهُمُ النَّهَارَ مُبْصِرًا لِيَبْتَغُوْا فِيْهِ مِنْ فَضْلِهِ
Translation: And He created for them the day giving sight that they might seek His bounty therein

Arabic text: وَلِيَتَسَبَّبُوْا إِلَى رِزْقِهِ، وَيَسْرَحُوْا فِيْ أَرْضِهِ
Translation: And strive for His provision, and move about in His earth

Arabic text: طَلَبًا لِمَا فِيـهِ نَيْلُ الْعَاجِلِ مِنْ دُنْيَاهُمْ
Translation: Seeking what brings immediate gain in their worldly affairs

Arabic text: وَدَرَكُ الَاجِلِ فِيْ اُخْرَاهُمْ بِكُلِّ ذٰلِكَ يُصْلِحُ شَأنَهُمْ
Translation: And attainment of the future in their hereafter. Through all this He rectifies their affairs

Arabic text: وَيَبْلُوْ أَخْبَارَهُمْ وَيَنْظُرُ كَيْفَ هُمْ فِيْ أَوْقَاتِ طَاعَتِـهِ
Translation: And tests their conduct and observes how they are in the times of His obedience

Arabic text: وَمَنَازِلِ فُـرُوضِهِ وَمَوَاقِعِ أَحْكَامِهِ
Translation: And the stations of His obligations and the places of His rulings

Arabic text: لِيَجْزِيَ الَّذِيْنَ أَسَاءُوْا بِمَا عَمِلُوْا وَيَجْزِيَ الَّذِيْنَ أَحْسَنُوْا بِالْحُسْنَى
Translation: That He may repay those who do evil with what they have done, and reward those who do good with goodness

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ عَلَى مَافَلَقْتَ لَنَا مِنَ الْإِصْبَاحِ
Translation: O Allah, to You belongs praise for what You have created for us of the morning

Arabic text: وَمَتَّعْتَنَا بِهِ مِنْ ضَوْءِ النَّهَارِ
Translation: And allowed us to enjoy of the light of day

Arabic text: وَبَصَّرْتَنَا مِنْ مَطَالِبِ الَاقْوَاتِ
Translation: And enabled us to see the ways of seeking provision

Arabic text: وَوَقَيْتَنَا فِيْهِ مِنْ طَوَارِقِ الْآفَاتِ
Translation: And protected us therein from the occurrences of calamities

Arabic text: أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَتِ الَاشْيَاءُ كُلُّهَا بِجُمْلَتِهَا لَكَ
Translation: We have entered the morning, and all things have entered the morning, in their entirety, belonging to You

Arabic text: سَمَاؤُهَا وَأَرْضُهَا وَمَا بَثَثْتَ
Translation: Their heaven and their earth and what You have spread

Arabic text: فِيْ كُلِّ وَاحِد مِنْهُمَا سَاكِنُهُ وَمُتَحَرِّكُهُ وَمُقِيمُهُ
Translation: In each of them, its inhabitants, its moving beings, and its stationed ones

Arabic text: وَشَاخِصُهُ وَمَا عَلَا فِيْ الْهَوَاءِ وَمَا كَنَّ تَحْتَ الثَّرَى
Translation: And its travelers, and what ascends in the air and what is hidden beneath the soil

Arabic text: أَصْبَحْنَا فِيْ قَبْضَتِكَ
Translation: We have entered the morning in Your grasp

Arabic text: يَحْوِينَا مُلْكُكَ وَسُلْطَانُكَ وَتَضُمُّنَا مَشِيَّتُكَ
Translation: Your kingdom and authority encompass us, and Your will contains us

Arabic text: وَنَتَصَرَّفُ عَنْ أَمْرِكَ، وَنَتَقَلَّبُ فِيْ تَدْبِيرِكَ
Translation: We act according to Your command, and move about within Your management

Arabic text: لَيْسَ لَنَا مِنَ الَامْرِ إِلَّا مَا قَضَيْتَ
Translation: We have no affair except what You have decreed

Arabic text: وَلَا مِنَ الْخَيْـرِ إِلَّا مَـا أَعْطَيْتَ
Translation: And no good except what You have given

Arabic text: وَهَذَا يَوْمٌ حَادِثٌ جَدِيدٌ، وَهُوَ عَلَيْنَا شَاهِدٌ عَتِيدٌ
Translation: And this is a new day, beginning afresh, and it is a witness over us, ready

Arabic text: اِنْ أَحْسَنَّا وَدَّعَنَا بِحَمْد، وَإِنْ أسَأنَا فَارَقَنَا بِذَمّ
Translation: If we do good, it will bid us farewell with praise, and if we do evil, it will part from us with blame

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِـهِ
Translation: O Allah, bless Muhammad and his family

Arabic text: وَارْزُقْنَـا حُسْنَ مُصَاحَبَتِهِ وَاعْصِمْنَا
Translation: And grant us the blessing of its companionship and protect us

Arabic text: مِنْ سُوْءِ مُفَارَقَتِهِ بِارْتِكَابِ جَرِيرَة
Translation: From the evil of parting from it by committing sins

Arabic text: أَوِ اقْتِرَافِ صَغِيرَة اَوْ كَبِيرَة
Translation: Or performing minor or major offenses

Arabic text: وَأجْزِلْ لَنَا فِيْهِ مِنَ الْحَسَنَاتِ وَأَخْلِنَا فِيْهِ مِنَ السَّيِّئاتِ
Translation: And give us abundant good deeds in it and empty us of evil deeds

Arabic text: وَامْلَا لَنَا مَا بَيْنَ طَرَفَيْهِ حَمْدًا وَشُكْرًا وَأَجْرًا وَذُخْرًا وَفَضْلًا وَإِحْسَانًا
Translation: And fill what is between its two ends with praise, gratitude, reward, treasure, favor, and kindness

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ يَسِّرْ عَلَى الْكِرَامِ الْكَاتِبِينَ مَؤُونَتَنَا
Translation: O Allah, ease for the noble scribes their task concerning us

Arabic text: وَامْلَا لَنَا مِنْ حَسَنَاتِنَا صَحَائِفَنَا
Translation: And fill our pages with our good deeds

Arabic text: وَلَا تُخْزِنَا عِنْدَهُمْ بِسُوءِ أَعْمَالِنَا
Translation: And do not disgrace us before them with our evil deeds

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ لَنَا فِيْ كُلِّ سَاعَة مِنْ سَاعَاتِهِ حَظًّا مِنْ عِبَادِكَ
Translation: O Allah, appoint for us in each hour of its hours a portion of Your worship

Arabic text: وَنَصِيْبًا مِنْ شُكْرِكَ وَشَاهِدَ صِدْقٍ مِنْ مَلَائِكَتِكَ
Translation: And a share of gratitude to You and truthful witnesses from Your angels

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ
Translation: O Allah, bless Muhammad and his family

Arabic text: وَاحْفَظْنَا مِنْ بَيْنِ أَيْدِيْنَا وَمِنْ خَلْفِنَا وَعَنْ أَيْمَانِنَا وَعَنْ شَمَائِلِنَا
Translation: And guard us from before us and behind us, on our right and on our left

Arabic text: وَمِنْ جَمِيْعِ نَوَاحِيْنَا حِفْظًا عَاصِمًا مِنْ مَعْصِيَتِكَ
Translation: And from all our sides, with a guarding that will protect us from disobeying You

Arabic text: هَادِيًا إِلَى طَاعَتِكَ مُسْتَعْمِلًا لِمَحَبَّتِكَ
Translation: Guide us to obeying You, and employ us in Your love

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ
Translation: O Allah, bless Muhammad and his family

Arabic text: وَوَفِّقْنَا فِيْ يَوْمِنَا هٰذَا وَلَيْلَتِنَا هٰذِهِ وَفِيْ جَمِيْعِ أَيَّامِنَا
Translation: And guide us in this day of ours and this night of ours and in all our days

Arabic text: لِاسْتِعْمَالِ الْخَيْرِ وَهِجْـرَانِ الشَرِّ وَشُكْـرِ النِّعَمِ
Translation: To employ goodness, to avoid evil, to thank for blessings

Arabic text: وَاتِّبَـاعِ السُّنَنِ وَمُجَانَبَةِ البِدَعِ
Translation: To follow the traditions, and to avoid innovations

Arabic text: وَالْأَمْرِ بِـالْمَعْرُوفِ وَالنَّهيِ عَنِ الْمُنْكَرِ
Translation: To enjoin good and forbid evil

Arabic text: وَحِيَاطَةِ الْإِسْلاَمِ وَانْتِقَاصِ الْبَاطِلِ وَإِذْلاَلِهِ
Translation: To defend Islam, to diminish falsehood and humiliate it

Arabic text: وَنُصْرَةِ الْحَقِّ وَإِعْزَازِهِ، وَإِرْشَادِ الضَّالِّ
Translation: To support truth and strengthen it, to guide the misguided

Arabic text: وَمُعَاوَنَةِ الضَّعِيفِ وَإِدْرَاكِ اللَّهِيْفِ
Translation: To help the weak and assist the distressed

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ
Translation: O Allah, bless Muhammad and his family

Arabic text: وَاجْعَلْهُ أَيْمَنَ يَوْمٍ عَهِدْنَاهُ
Translation: And make it the most blessed day we have known

Arabic text: وَأَفْضَلَ صَاحِبٍ صَحِبْنَاهُ
Translation: And the best companion we have accompanied

Arabic text: وَخَيْرَ وَقْتٍ ظَلِلْنَا فِيْهِ
Translation: And the best time we have lived in

Arabic text: وَاجْعَلْنَا مِنْ أَرْضَى مَنْ مَرَّ عَلَيْهِ اللَّيْـلُ وَالنَّهَارُ مِنْ جُمْلَةِ خَلْقِكَ
Translation: And make us among the most satisfied of those upon whom night and day have passed from all Your creation

Arabic text: وَأَشْكَـرَهُمْ لِمَا اَوْلَيْتَ مِنْ نِعَمِكَ
Translation: And the most thankful of them for the blessings You have granted

Arabic text: وَأَقْوَمَهُمْ بِمَـا شَرَعْتَ مِنْ شَرَائِعِكَ
Translation: And the most steadfast of them in following what You have legislated of Your laws

Arabic text: وَأَوْقَفَهُمْ عَمَّا حَذَّرْتَ مِنْ نَهْيِكَ
Translation: And the most heedful of them of what You have warned against in Your prohibitions

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّيْ أُشْهِدُكَ وَكَفَى بِكَ شَهِيدًا وَ اُشْهِدُ سَمَاءَكَ وَأَرْضَكَ
Translation: O Allah, I call You to witness, and sufficient are You as a witness, and I call to witness Your heaven and Your earth

Arabic text: وَمَنْ أَسْكَنْتَهُمَا مِنْ مَلَائِكَتِـكَ وَسَائِرِ خَلْقِكَ فِيْ يَوْمِيْ هَذَا
Translation: And whoever You have settled in them of Your angels and the rest of Your creation in this day of mine

Arabic text: وَسَاعَتِيْ هَذِهِ، وَلَيْلَتِيْ هَذِهِ، وَمُسْتَقَرِّيْ هَذَا
Translation: And this hour of mine, and this night of mine, and this my place of rest

Arabic text: أَنِّيْ أَشْهَدُ أَنَّكَ اَنْتَ اللَّهُ، اَلَّذِي
Translation: That I bear witness that You are Allah, the One

Arabic text: لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ قَائِمٌ بِـالْقِسْطِ
Translation: There is no god but You, standing firm in justice

Arabic text: عَدْلٌ فِيْ الْحُكْم، رَؤُوفٌ بِالْعِبَادِ
Translation: Just in judgment, kind to the servants

Arabic text: مَالِكُ المُلْكِ رَحِيمٌ بِالْخَلْقِ
Translation: Master of the Kingdom, merciful to creation

Arabic text: وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُكَ وَرَسُوْلُكَ وَخِيَرَتُكَ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ
Translation: And that Muhammad is Your servant and Your messenger and Your chosen one from Your creation

Arabic text: حَمَّلْتَهُ رِسَالَتَكَ فَأَدَّاهَا وَأَمَرْتَهُ بِالنُّصْحِ لِأُمَّتِهِ فَنَصَحَ لَهَا
Translation: You entrusted him with Your message and he delivered it, and You commanded him to give good counsel to his community and he gave it

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ أَكْثَرَ مَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى أَحَدٍ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ
Translation: O Allah, bless Muhammad and his family more than You have blessed anyone of Your creation

Arabic text: وَ آتِهِ عَنَّا أَفْضَلَ مَا آتَيْتَ أَحَدًا مِنْ عِبَادِكَ
Translation: And give him on our behalf better than what You have given to any of Your servants

Arabic text: وَاجْزِهِ عَنَّا أَفْضَلَ وَأَكْرَمَ مَا جَزَيْتَ أَحَدًا مِنْ أَنْبِيَائِـكَ عَنْ أُمَّتِهِ
Translation: And reward him on our behalf better and more generously than You have rewarded any of Your prophets on behalf of his community

Arabic text: إِنَّـكَ أَنْتَ الْمَنَّانُ بِالْجَسِيمِ الْغَـافِر لِلْعَظِيمِ
Translation: Surely You are the Bestower of great things, the Forgiver of mighty things

Arabic text: وَأَنْتَ أَرْحَمُ مِنْ كُلِّ رَحِيم
Translation: And You are more merciful than every merciful one

Arabic text: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ
Translation: So bless Muhammad and his family

Arabic text: اَلطَّيِّبِينَ الطَّاهِرِينَ الْاَخْيَارِ الَانْجَبِينَ
Translation: The good, the pure, the chosen, the distinguished
